import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from mcp import ClientSession, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

CASES = {
 'young_women_unemployment': ('flow:DF_ISGUCU_AYLIK_TEMEL_ISGUCU_C+V1.0', {'Temel Yaş':'15-24','Cinsiyet':'Kadın','İşgücü Göstergeleri':'İşsizlik Oranı (%)','Mevsimsel Düzeltme':'Mevsim etkilerinden arındırılmış'}),
 'istanbul_population': ('flow:DF_ADNKS_T14+V1.1', {'İkamet edilen yer (_T)':'İstanbul','Yerleşim Yeri türü (_T)':'Toplam','Cinsiyet (_T)':'Toplam'}),
 'first_hand_housing': ('flow:DF_SATIS_SEKLI_SATIS_DURUMU_V3+V1.0', {'Satış Türü (_T)':'İlk El Satış','İstatistiksel Gösterge (MII_KSS)':'Konut Satış Sayıları','Adet Pay Oranı (_T)':'Adet'}),
}

async def main():
 report={'method':'single_ai_scope_checks','started_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'checks':{},'collector_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'collector_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 params=StdioServerParameters(command=sys.executable,args=['-m','tuik_mcp.server'],env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k.startswith('TUIK_')})
 async with stdio_client(params) as (read,write):
  async with ClientSession(read,write) as session:
   await session.initialize()
   for name,(rid,filters) in CASES.items():
    profile=(await session.call_tool('inspect_tuik_data',{'resource_id':rid,'max_values':100})).structuredContent
    assert profile and profile['status']=='ok',profile
    columns={c['name']:{v['value'] for v in c['values']} for c in profile['columns']}
    assert all(value in columns.get(key,set()) for key,value in filters.items()),filters
    args={'resource_id':rid,'filters':filters,'limit':2}
    result=(await session.call_tool('get_tuik_data',args)).structuredContent
    assert result and result['status']=='ok' and result['total_rows']>0,result
    assert result['snapshot_id']==profile['snapshot_id'],result
    assert all(all(row[k]==v for k,v in filters.items()) for row in result['rows']),result
    report['checks'][name]={'profile':profile,'arguments':args,'result':result}
    print(name,result['total_rows'],flush=True)
 report['finished_at']=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
 report['status']='ok'
 Path('docs/verification/search-ai-scope-checks-2026-11-04.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
asyncio.run(main())
